transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I just... I don't really feel like myself anymore. I don't know. I stopped doing things. Hiking, coaching... even playing my guitar. I don't call people back. Some days I just sit in my rental place for hours. I know there are things I should be doing, but... I just can't make myself start. That's all.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
No, not really sad. Just... empty, I guess. I don't feel much of anything.
Do you still enjoy things you used to like?
Not really. Like I was saying before... I stopped with the guitar and the hiking. I just don't get anything out of it now. I don't care to do them. It's just... easier to sit at my place.
Do you feel anxious?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really worried about anything. Just... quiet.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep?
No... not really. I just sleep. It's about the same, I guess.
Do you often feel guilty about anything?
No. Not really. I haven't... there's nothing I did. So, no.
Do you still enjoy things you used to like is not a good follow up since it was already asked, so: Have you lost interest in activities that you once found pleasurable?

I guess... yeah. I just don't really feel like myself anymore. 

I stopped doing most things. Hiking... playing guitar. Coaching. I don't call anyone back. Some days I just... sit in my rental for hours. I know there's stuff to do. I just... can't make myself start.
Do you feel pleasure when you do things?
Not really. I just... I don't feel much of anything. It's just flat.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to?
I don't know. I haven't really noticed. I mean... I'm mostly just sitting anyway. So... no. I don't think so.
Have you noticed any change in your weight?
I haven't really paid attention to it. I don't... I don't think so.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to live?
No. I don't... really think about that. Just... no.
Do you feel worthless?
Not really. I don't... focus on that kind of thing. I'm just... here.
Do you feel tired most of the time?
No. I... I have enough energy, I guess. I just... do what I have to do.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About... a year and two months, I guess. Ever since I moved into that smaller rental. After the... divorce. Things just started unraveling around then.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt this way?
I don't... I don't really keep track of it like that. In weeks, I mean. It's just... been how it is. For a long time.
Do you ever feel depressed?
I don't... I wouldn't call it that. I just... I don't really think about it like that. I'm just getting through the days, I guess.
Have you noticed any significant change in your appetite?
I haven't really noticed. I just eat when I have to.
Do you feel depressed most days?
I don't know. Like I said, I just... I don't really look at it like that. I'm just here.
Have you had any episodes where you felt even more empty or down than you do now?
Not really. It just... it all kind of stays the same. I don't really keep track of worse or better.
Do you feel better, even if only slightly, when good things happen to you?
I don't really know. Things just... happen. I don't feel much different either way.
